cultural.vision_reason: Studio portrait of five Ute men in traditional dress (beaded chokers, dentalium ornaments, quillwork sash, peace medal) alongside three White officials/interpreters; documentary photo showing Ute dress and adornment fits the claimed ethnicity.

physical.title: photographic print (black and white); album
physical.summary:
Photograph (black and white) from an album; studio portrait of five Ute men and three White men standing and seated in two rows; the White men are wearing suits and bow ties; the five Ute men are wearing, top row from left to right; the first man is wearing a western-style jacket, a hat, a beaded choker, a quillwork sash and a peace medal; the second man is wearing a western-style jacket, a hat, a metal ear ornament and a beaded choker; the third man is wearing a western-style jacket with fringe detail, a hat, dentalium ear ornaments, and a dentalium choker; bottom row from left to right; the first man is wearing a western-style jacket, a peace medal, a dentalium choker, and a quillwork sash, his hair is in two bunches wrapped in fur and he has a blanket over his knees; the second man is wearing a checked shirt, and a beaded and bear claw choker, his hair is in two bunches wrapped in beaded tubes and he has a blanket over his knees; Washington D.C, United States of America. 
Albumen print
